basic_info.description: NEW PRICE! Experience breathtaking Golden Gate Bridge views from this classic 2-level Tudor Revival with modern luxuries in the heart of Russian Hill. Situated high above the street, this quiet urban oasis lives like a single-family home w/ its own private entrance and no one living above or below. The home includes a newly added luxury elevator whisking you securely from the incredibly cool garage directly to the condo entrance level. The home's charm includes pocket doors, leaded glass windows, 3 gas fireplaces, window benches, hardwood floors and beamed ceiling detail. From the inviting foyer you are drawn to the stunning Bay & Bridge views in the spacious FLR w/ oversized windows. The classic DR oozes charm and leads to the remodeled kitchen featuring name brand cabinet-front appliances and under cabinet lighting. The chic remodeled full bath, laundry & private garden are on this level. You'll find 3 bedrooms on the upper level including the primary with extensive closets, gas frplc & views of the GG Bridge! 2 well-scaled bedrooms and a remodeled bath are found on this level. Upgrades: newer shared luxury elevator, central A/C, dual pane windows, updated frplc &  newer W/D. Completing this rare offering is one of the Coolest Garages in S.F. with 2 parking spots + storage.
